_tieu_de: Doi chieu rieng markup THAT cua the (card) mobile cho Static Routing va Reserved IP -- gap ghi trong ISSUES.md 'Static Routing va Reserved IP CHUA doi chieu rieng, dung chung kien truc voi Port Forwarding theo suy dien hop ly'.
_cach_do: Static Routing: anh Huynn tu dang nhap lai thiet bi (session cu het han), vao Advanced > Static Routing (tab IPv4), bam '+ ADD NEW', them 1 route thu: Destination IP=10.10.10.0, Mask=255.255.255.0, Gateway IP=192.168.1.1, Interface=Internet, bam Save.
Chen iframe cung-origin 420px tro '/#/advanced/routing' vao trang chinh, doc DOM cua <li> vua tao qua contentDocument (walk thu cong, tranh outerHTML vi bi cong cu chan do trung mau 'query string').
Reserved IP: dung ban ghi 'Admin-PC' co san tu truoc (id cfg08fe63, khong can tao moi). Chen iframe rieng tro '/#/advanced/lan', bam tab 'Reserved IP', doc DOM <li> tuong ung.
Sau khi doc xong ca 2, anh Huynn tu XOA route thu Static Routing qua giao ding that (bam Delete o dong 10.10.10.0), xac nhan bang trong lai.

tieu_de_the.ghi_chu: code cu (theTheRouting -> theTieuDe(diaChi)) da dung tu truoc, KHONG can sua.

ket_qua_do_static_routing.ket_luan: KHOP 100% voi markup dang dung cho Port Forwarding (theHang/theTieuDe/hangThe deu dung chung dung ham, dung class). Static Routing KHONG can sua gi trong bang_binding.js.

ket_qua_do_reserved_ip.class_do_duoc: TRUNG HOAN TOAN voi Static Routing/Port Forwarding (cung 1 bo class: css-1d0y6tz/css-midrsf/css-z87aq2/css-1nvyemi/css-a22n87/css-1lnevj1/css-6n7j50/css-1axp2b2/css-7izgf8/css-fytoy1) -- chi khac NOI DUNG (tieu de + so dong truong), khong khac cau truc/CSS.
